'''East Ridge Outpost''' is a dwarven outpost in the [[Grim Reaches]] located just west of the pass into the [[Wetlands]]. [[Mountaineer Steelwind]] can be found here, as well as an armorer named [[Dorlegg Firegrip]]. Sent all the way from [[Ironforge]] by the [[Redbrand Estate]] is also [[Garlin Redbrand]].
